performance_case.causal_mechanism: Large complete-UTC-day BTC close-to-close shocks may leave liquidity, positioning and uncertainty in a persistent elevated-risk state, causing next-complete-day realized variance to remain above a fixed trailing pre-shock baseline across years and both UP and DOWN shocks.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one pre-2025 descriptive volatility-persistence prior from the exact sealed H1 corpus and frozen event, variance, baseline, window and gate definitions. It cannot access post-2024 or forward outcomes, establish causality or prediction, choose a risk budget, sizing rule, side, entry, exit, factor transform, strategy, adapter or parameter, change an evaluator or source, compute economic performance, create a hypothesis/candidate/manifest/experiment, open OOS, deploy or authorize Trading.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: If untouched forward evidence later confirms elevated next-day risk and a separately preregistered equal-capital strategy reduces exposure without excessive missed positive convexity, drawdown may improve; this historical diagnostic itself has zero immediate drawdown effect and leaves all path-risk economics MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A frozen historical test can reject an unstable shock-risk mechanism before spending implementation and candidate budget, while a retained result identifies exactly one future diagnostic rather than a family of tunable volatility controls. Waiting only for R1 or R2 would leave this independent risk question unanswered.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The diagnostic itself cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL. Only later untouched forward confirmation followed by one separately frozen matched-capital risk-control experiment could establish whether the mechanism improves fee-adjusted PnL or drawdown.
